citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-231. Failure to furnish supplies, negligence (2023)
content:
A failure to furnish timbers and materials as required shall be deemed an offense
   against this act, and shall be taken to be negligence per se on the part of the operator,
   superintendent and mine foreman of such mine, in an1action for the recovery of damages for accidents resulting from the insufficient
   propping of such mine, through failure to furnish the necessary props or timbers.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Mine Foreman and Mine Examiner; Examination and Safety of Working Places›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-230. Operator, superintendent, mine foreman to furnish supplies
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › D. Mine Foreman and Mine Examiner; Examination and Safety of Working Places › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-230. Operator, superintendent, mine foreman to furnish supplies
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-230. Operator, superintendent, mine foreman to furnish supplies (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of the operator, superintendent and mine foreman of every mine
   to furnish to the miners all props, ties, rails, timbers and materials necessary for
   the safe mining of coal and for the protection of the lives of the workmen.  Such props, ties, rails, timbers and materials shall be suitably prepared and shall
   be delivered to the workmen as near to their working places as they can be conveyed
   in ordinary mine cars free of charge.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › D. Mine Foreman and Mine Examiner; Examination and Safety of Working Places › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-228. Stations at entrance to mine or parts of mine
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-228. Stations at entrance to mine or parts of mine (2023)
content:
A station or stations shall be established at the entrance to each mine or different
   parts of each mine, as the case may require, and a workman shall not pass beyond any
   such station until the mine or part of the mine beyond the same has been inspected
   by the mine foreman, assistant mine foreman or mine examiner and reported to be safe.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › D. Mine Foreman and Mine Examiner; Examination and Safety of Working Places › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-229. Withdrawal of workmen, noxious gases
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-229. Withdrawal of workmen, noxious gases (2023)
content:
If, at any time, it is found by the person in charge of a mine or any part thereof,
   that by reason of noxious gases prevailing in such mine or such part thereof, or of
   any cause whatever the mine or the said part is dangerous, every precaution shall
   be used to ensure the safety of the workmen;  and every workman, except such persons
   as may be required to remove the danger, shall be withdrawn from the mine, or such
   part thereof as is so found dangerous, until the said mine or said part thereof is
   examined by the mine foreman, assistant mine foreman or mine examiner and reported
   by him to be safe.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-232. Unlawful to employ person not competent to understand regulations concerning explosive gases (2023)
content:
It shall not be lawful for any mine foreman or superintendent of any mine or colliery
   to employ any person who is not competent to understand the regulations of any mine
   evolving explosive gases;  provided that this rule shall not apply to a mine free
   from the said explosive gases.

Certified miners only to blast coal or rock
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Certified miners only to blast coal or rock
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-234. Certified miners only to blast coal or rock (2023)
content:
No person shall be permitted to blast coal or rock unless he is a certified miner
   and in the opinion of the mine foreman is qualified by experience and judgment to
   perform the work with ordinary safety.

Firing lines, supervision of mine foreman
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-235. Firing lines, supervision of mine foreman (2023)
content:
The location of the firing lines and safety breaks shall be under the supervision
   of the mine foreman or his assistant.

Mine foreman, permission for blasts in mine where locked safety lamps are in use
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › E. Mine Foreman; Blasting › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-233. Mine foreman, permission for blasts in mine where locked safety lamps are in use
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-233. Mine foreman, permission for blasts in mine where locked safety lamps are in use (2023)
content:
No blast shall be fired in any mine where locked safety lamps are used except by permission
   of the mine foreman or his assistants.

Mine foreman to supervise misfires
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Mine foreman to supervise misfires
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-236. Mine foreman to supervise misfires (2023)
content:
The handling of a misfired blast shall be under the supervision of the mine foreman
   or his assistant.

Passageways, well drained

Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › F. Mine Foreman; Drainage › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-237. Passageways, well drained
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-237. Passageways, well drained (2023)
content:
Passageways used by persons and roads used for transportation in any mine shall be
   well drained.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Regulations, places approaching inaccessible workings
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › F. Mine Foreman; Drainage › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-238. Regulations, places approaching inaccessible workings
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-238. Regulations, places approaching inaccessible workings (2023)
content:
Whenever a place is approaching inaccessible workings, the operator shall establish
   and clearly show on the map furnished the mine foreman a stopping distance not less
   than one hundred feet from the said inaccessible workings and such stopping point
   shall not be passed until after the coal company officials, the mining engineer and
   the mine inspector have agreed on the width of any such approaching place or places,
   the point at which test holes shall be started and the location of the test holes.  The test holes shall not be less than twenty feet in advance of the working face
   with sufficient flank holes on each side of said place.  No such stopping distance shall be less than one hundred feet from the said inaccessible
   abandoned workings, nor need it be greater than the distance calculated in accordance
   with the rule commonly used in the establishing of barrier pillars, namely, one per
   cent of the depth below drainage times the thickness of the coal seam plus thickness
   of seam times five, excepting in such cases where calculation in accordance with said
   rule establishes a stopping distance of less than one hundred feet.  This act does not permit the driving of gangways, chambers or other excavations
   into barriers which are subjected to their maximum water pressure, as calculated in
   accordance with the rule here established, unless the said waterhead is reduced by
   pumping or other means.  The term“mining engineer,”as used in this act, shall mean the person who shall, in behalf of the operator,
   have charge or general supervision of the work of compiling the mine map.

Examine for gas before and after firing blast
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-243. Examine for gas before and after firing blast
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-243. Examine for gas before and after firing blast (2023)
content:
Examinations for gas shall be made immediately before firing each blast or group of
   blasts.  Before work is commenced an examination of the face shall be made.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-241. Issue warning to all persons in proximity before firing blast
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-241. Issue warning to all persons in proximity before firing blast
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-241. Issue warning to all persons in proximity before firing blast (2023)
content:
When a miner is about to fire a blast he shall notify the persons in the adjoining
   places and shall have received a reply therefrom and shall give sufficient alarm so
   that any person or persons who may be approaching shall be warned of the danger before
   firing the blast.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-239. Secure roof and sides
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-239. Secure roof and sides
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-239. Secure roof and sides (2023)
content:
Any person having charge of a working place in any mine shall keep the roof and sides
   thereof properly secured by timber or otherwise so as to prevent such roof and sides
   from falling, and he shall not do any work or permit any work to be done under loose
   or dangerous material except for the purpose of securing the same.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-245. Extinguish gas ignited by blast, notify mine foreman
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-245. Extinguish gas ignited by blast, notify mine foreman
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-245. Extinguish gas ignited by blast, notify mine foreman (2023)
content:
When gas is ignited by blast or otherwise, the person igniting the same shall immediately
   extinguish it, if possible, and notify the mine foreman or his assistant of the fact,
   and workmen must see that no gas blowers are left burning upon leaving their working
   places.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-244. Shall not detonate blast in presence of methane
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-244. Shall not detonate blast in presence of methane
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-244. Shall not detonate blast in presence of methane (2023)
content:
Blasts shall not be detonated in any place where methane can be detected with a flame
   safety lamp.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-242. Leg wires of electric detonators to be kept shunted
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-242. Leg wires of electric detonators to be kept shunted
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-242. Leg wires of electric detonators to be kept shunted (2023)
content:
The leg wires of electric detonators shall be kept shunted until ready to connect
   to the firing cable.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-240. Tight cartridge not to be rammed into blast hole
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-240. Tight cartridge not to be rammed into blast hole
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-240. Tight cartridge not to be rammed into blast hole (2023)
content:
In charging holes for blasting in coal, slate or rock in any mine, a tight cartridge
   shall not be rammed into the hole by any means.  Only nonmetallic tamping bars shall be used for charging and tamping blast holes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-247. Thirty minute waiting period before returning to misfire
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-247. Thirty minute waiting period before returning to misfire
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-247. Thirty minute waiting period before returning to misfire (2023)
content:
Where misfires occur with electric detonators, a waiting period of at least thirty
   minutes shall elapse before anyone returns to the misfired hole or holes.  The blasting wires shall be disconnected from the blasting battery and the ends
   of the blasting wires short-circuited before returning to the misfire hole or holes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-246. Misfired explosives not to be withdrawn
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-246. Misfired explosives not to be withdrawn
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-246. Misfired explosives not to be withdrawn (2023)
content:
A charge of explosives in coal, slate or rock, which has misfired shall not be withdrawn
   or the hole reopened.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-250. Notify mine foreman of any dangerous condition
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-250. Notify mine foreman of any dangerous condition
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-250. Notify mine foreman of any dangerous condition (2023)
content:
Any miner or other workman who shall discover anything wrong with the ventilating
   current or with the condition of the roof, side, timber, or roadway or with any other
   part of the mine in general, such as would lead him to suspect danger to himself or
   his fellow workmen or to the property of his employer, shall immediately report the
   same to the mine foreman or other certified person for the time being in charge of
   that portion of the mine.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-248. Method of removing misfired explosives
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-248. Method of removing misfired explosives
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-248. Method of removing misfired explosives (2023)
content:
Explosives in misfired blast holes shall be removed by drilling a separate blast hole
   two feet distant from and parallel to the hole containing the misfired charge and
   then charging and detonating the explosives in this new hole.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-249. Order props, ties, rails, timber, materials at least one day in advance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-249. Order props, ties, rails, timber, materials at least one day in advance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-249. Order props, ties, rails, timber, materials at least one day in advance (2023)
content:
Every workman in want of props, ties, rails, timbers or materials shall notify the
   mine foreman or his assistant of the fact at least one day in advance, giving the
   length of the props or timber required;  and in case of danger from loose roof or
   sides, he shall not continue to cut or load coal or do any other work within the danger
   area until the said props and timber have been properly furnished and the place made
   secure.

Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-252. Accumulation of gas not to be removed by brushing
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-252. Accumulation of gas not to be removed by brushing
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-252. Accumulation of gas not to be removed by brushing (2023)
content: An accumulation of gas in mines shall not be removed by brushing.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-251. Penalty endangering lives, health of workmen, security of property
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-251. Penalty endangering lives, health of workmen, security of property
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-251. Penalty endangering lives, health of workmen, security of property (2023)
content:
Any person or persons who shall knowingly or wilfully damage, or without proper authority
   remove or render useless any fencing, means of signaling, apparatus, instrument or
   machine, or shall throw open or obstruct any airway, or open a ventilating door and
   not have the same closed, or enter a place in or about a mine against caution, or
   carry fire, open lights, matches or any device for making lights or fire not authorized
   or approved in places where safety lamps are used, or handle without proper authority,
   or disturb any machinery or cars, or do any other act or thing whereby the lives or
   health of persons or the security of the property in or about a mine or colliery are
   endangered, shall be guilty of an offense against this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-253. Props or timbers supporting roof not to be removed by cutting, removed by blasting or prop puller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-253. Props or timbers supporting roof not to be removed by cutting, removed by blasting or prop puller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-253. Props or timbers supporting roof not to be removed by cutting, removed by blasting or prop puller (2023)
content:
No person or persons working in any coal mine or colliery shall cut any props or timbers
   while the same are in position to support the roof or sides.  When it becomes necessary to remove any of the said props or timbers they shall
   be removed by blasting or by means of a prop puller.  Such prop puller, however, shall be designed and constructed with ropes or chains
   of sufficient length that the person operating the device will not be exposed to the
   danger of a falling roof or falling coal resulting from the removal of such props
   and timbers.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-255. Examine place for gas prior to start of work and other times
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-255. Examine place for gas prior to start of work and other times
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-255. Examine place for gas prior to start of work and other times (2023)
content:
Before the commencement of work the miner in charge shall examine his working place
   for gas and oxygen deficiency with an approved safety lamp and thoroughly test the
   roof, face and ribs with a suitable testing bar.  A similar test shall also be made before starting any machine, before and after
   each blast fired during the working shift.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-254. System of roof support
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-254. System of roof support
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-254. System of roof support (2023)
content:
The roof in all underground areas shall be supported as outlined in sections 269 and
   270 of this article.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-257. Roof support to be placed promptly as soon as room available
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-257. Roof support to be placed promptly as soon as room available
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-257. Roof support to be placed promptly as soon as room available (2023)
content:
All props and timbers shall be placed promptly, as soon as the room to do so is made
   available, and shall be adequate and proper for the needs of the place.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-256. Correct unsafe roof, face or rib conditions before other work started
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-256. Correct unsafe roof, face or rib conditions before other work started
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-256. Correct unsafe roof, face or rib conditions before other work started (2023)
content:
If roof, face or rib conditions are found to be unsafe, they shall be corrected by
   taking down loose material, or shall be securely supported, before other work is started.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-260. Superintendent shall direct and provide means for law compliance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-260. Superintendent shall direct and provide means for law compliance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-260. Superintendent shall direct and provide means for law compliance (2023)
content:
The superintendent shall not obstruct the mine foreman or other officials in the fulfillment
   of any of their duties as required by this act, but he shall direct, provide the means,
   and see to it that the mine foreman and all other employes under him comply with the
   law in all its provisions.  He shall give immediate attention to any violation of the law called to his attention
   by the mine inspector.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-259. Mine not to be operated without supervision of mine foreman
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-259. Mine not to be operated without supervision of mine foreman
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-259. Mine not to be operated without supervision of mine foreman (2023)
content:
No mine shall be operated without the supervision of a mine foreman.  In case any mine is worked without a mine foreman, the operator or superintendent
   thereof shall be subjected to a penalty of fifty dollars ($50) per day for each day
   during which the said mine is operated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-261. Superintendent or operator, supervision, direction and control of all employes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-261. Superintendent or operator, supervision, direction and control of all employes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-261. Superintendent or operator, supervision, direction and control of all employes (2023)
content:
The operator or superintendent of a mine or colliery shall use every precaution to
   insure the safety of the workmen in all cases, whether provided for in this act or
   not, and shall have supervision, direction, and control of the mine foreman and all
   other mine employes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-262. Safety committee; superintendent; monthly report of safety meeting
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-262. Safety committee; superintendent; monthly report of safety meeting
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-262. Safety committee; superintendent; monthly report of safety meeting (2023)
content:
If a safety committee has not been selected by the employes, a safety committee consisting
   of the mine superintendent, mine foreman, at least one assistant mine foreman, or,
   in the absence of such officials, a designated qualified agent or agents of the operator
   and at least two persons selected by the employes working in the mine shall be formed
   to acquaint the workers with the shortcomings of the mine as indicated by the State
   mine inspector and prescribing appropriate precautions and remedial action.  The mine superintendent shall execute, on behalf of the safety committee a monthly
   report on the last work day of each calendar month with the Department of Mines and
   Mineral Industries1containing a statement that the committee met and a summary of the information that
   was furnished to the employes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›G. Duties of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-258. Props, timbers, properly hitched, spragged, blocked, lined and lagged
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › G. Duties of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-258. Props, timbers, properly hitched, spragged, blocked, lined and lagged
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-258. Props, timbers, properly hitched, spragged, blocked, lined and lagged (2023)
content: All props and timbers shall be properly hitched.  It necessary they shall be spragged or braced, blocked, lined and lagged and cribbed.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-264. Authorize mine foreman to employ assistants
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-264. Authorize mine foreman to employ assistants
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-264. Authorize mine foreman to employ assistants (2023)
content:
Whenever a mine foreman cannot personally carry out the provisions of this act so
   far as they pertain to him, the operator or superintendent shall authorize him to
   employ a sufficient number of competent persons to act as his assistants, who shall
   be subject to his orders.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-263. Superintendent to provide supplies and materials to mine foreman (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of every superintendent, on behalf and at the expense of the
   operator, to keep on hand at each mine at all times a sufficient quantity of all materials
   and supplies required to preserve the health and safety of the employes, as ordered
   by the mine foreman, and required by this act.  If, for any reason, the superintendent cannot procure the necessary materials or
   supplies as aforesaid, he shall at once notify the mine foreman, whose duty it shall
   be to withdraw the men from the mine, or portion of mine, until such materials or
   supplies are received.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-265. Superintendent or operator to provide and maintain constant and adequate supply of pure air for mine or colliery
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-265. Superintendent or operator to provide and maintain constant and adequate supply of pure air for mine or colliery
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-265. Superintendent or operator to provide and maintain constant and adequate supply of pure air for mine or colliery (2023)
content:
The operator or superintendent of every mine or colliery shall provide and maintain
   a constant and adequate supply of pure air for the same, as hereinafter provided for
   in article V.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-266. Superintendent or operator to employ outside foreman
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-266. Superintendent or operator to employ outside foreman
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-266. Superintendent or operator to employ outside foreman (2023)
content:
The operator or superintendent of a colliery shall place a competent person to be
   called “outside foreman,” in charge of the breaker and the outside work of such colliery,
   who shall direct and as far as practicable see that the provisions of this act are
   complied with in respect to the breaker, outside machinery, ropes, cages and all other
   things pertaining to the outside work, unless otherwise provided for in this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-268. Superintendent or operator to furnish reports to mine inspectors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-268. Superintendent or operator to furnish reports to mine inspectors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-268. Superintendent or operator to furnish reports to mine inspectors (2023)
content:
The operator or superintendent of each mine or colliery shall furnish the district
   mine inspector with all reports and notices hereinbefore or hereinafter cited in this
   act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-267. Superintendent or operator to have right to hire and discharge employes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-267. Superintendent or operator to have right to hire and discharge employes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-267. Superintendent or operator to have right to hire and discharge employes (2023)
content:
The right to hire and discharge employes, the management of the mine, and the direction
   of the working forces, are vested exclusively in the operator or superintendent and
   no person or persons, association or associations, organization or organizations,
   or corporation or corporations, shall interfere with or attempt to interfere with,
   abridge or attempt to abridge, in any manner whatsoever, such right, provided that
   this does not invalidate any existing or future contract.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-201. Employment of mine foreman
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-201. Employment of mine foreman
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-201. Employment of mine foreman (2023)
content:
It shall not be lawful, neither shall it be permitted, for any person or persons to
   act as mine foreman, assistant mine foreman or mine examiner of any coal mine or colliery,
   unless they are registered as a holder of a certificate of qualification or service
   under this act.  The mine foreman shall have full charge of all the inside workings and the persons
   employed therein, subject, however, to the supervision and control of the operator
   or the superintendent, in order that all the provisions of this act, so far as they
   relate to his duties, shall be complied with and the regulations prescribed for each
   class of workmen under his charge carried out in the strictest manner possible.  Nothing in this article shall prevent a mine foreman or assistant mine foreman from
   acting as a mine examiner in case of an emergency.  Upon the effective date of this act and after an examination has been given for
   the certification of mine foremen, assistant mine foremen, and mine examiner, it shall
   be unlawful for any operator or superintendent to employ a mine examiner who has not
   been certified as such by the Department of Mines and Mineral Industries.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-202. Boards of examiners; mine foreman, assistant foreman and mine examiner; certificates
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-202. Boards of examiners; mine foreman, assistant foreman and mine examiner; certificates
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-202. Boards of examiners; mine foreman, assistant foreman and mine examiner; certificates (2023)
content:
For the purpose of examination of candidates for such certificate, a board of examiners
   shall be appointed in each of the inspection districts provided for by this act.  The said board shall consist of the district inspector of mines, two practical miners
   and one engineer, operator, or superintendent of a mine.  The said inspector shall act ex officio and the said boards shall be appointed by
   the courts of common pleas of the county in which the inspection districts are located.  The said boards shall act as such for the period of one year from the date of their
   appointment.  Meetings of the board may be held at any time and they may make such rules and conduct
   such examinations as in their judgment may seem proper for the purpose of such examinations.  The said board shall report their action to the Secretary of the Department of Mines
   and Mineral Industries,1and at least three of the members thereof shall certify to the qualification of each
   candidate who has passed such examination.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-203. Compensation of boards of examiners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-203. Compensation of boards of examiners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-203. Compensation of boards of examiners (2023)
content:
Each board member, with the exception of the mine inspector members, shall receive
   thirty dollars ($30) a day for each day actually employed, not exceeding ten days
   in all during the year, together with traveling expenses at the prevailing State rate
   for each mile necessarily traveled in going from his home to the place of meeting
   and return, by the shortest practicable route.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-269. Minimum timbering or other roof support methods adopted
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-269. Minimum timbering or other roof support methods adopted
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-269. Minimum timbering or other roof support methods adopted (2023)
content:
Where roof support is required, minimum timbering, or other roof support methods,
   suitable to the roof conditions of each mine or part of a mine shall be adopted by
   the operator and complied with.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-204. Records of examinations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-204. Records of examinations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-204. Records of examinations (2023)
content:
The board of examiners for the examination of applicants for mine foreman, assistant
   mine foreman, and mine examiner certificates shall send to the Secretary of the Department
   of Mines and Mineral Industries1duplicates of the manuscript and all other papers of applicants, together with the
   tally sheets and the solution of each question as given by the examining board, which
   shall be filed in the department as public documents for a period of time not less
   than eight years.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-270. Roof support plan not to exceed six feet centers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-270. Roof support plan not to exceed six feet centers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-270. Roof support plan not to exceed six feet centers (2023)
content:
Such plan shall specify the maximum center line distance between props, timbers, roof
   bolts or such other practical devices which shall, in no instance exceed six feet.  However, if conditions of the seam or seam roof warrant, additional roof support
   shall be placed without delay.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-205. Certificates of qualifications; fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-205. Certificates of qualifications; fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-205. Certificates of qualifications; fees (2023)
content:
Certificates of qualification to mine foremen, assistant mine foremen and mine examiner
   shall be granted by the Secretary of Mines and Mineral Industries1to every applicant who may be reported by the examiners as having passed a satisfactory
   examination and as having given satisfactory evidence of at least five years' practical
   experience as a miner, and of good conduct, capability and sobriety.  The certificate shall be in manner and form as shall be prescribed by the Secretary
   of Mines and Mineral Industries and a record of all certificates issued shall be kept
   in the department.  Certificates of qualification and certificates of service shall contain the full
   name, age and place of birth of the applicant, and also the length and nature of his
   previous service in or about the mines.  Before the examination for certificates of qualification to mine foremen, assistant
   mine foremen, and mine examiners in the anthracite mines, each applicant shall pay
   a fee of two dollars ($2), and each successful applicant shall pay an additional fee
   of three dollars ($3) before receiving a certificate.  The money thus received from applicants shall be transmitted to the Secretary of
   the Department of Mines and Mineral Industries to be deposited in the State Treasury.  In case of the loss or destruction of a certificate, the Secretary of Mines and
   Mineral Industries shall, upon the presentation of satisfactory evidence of the loss
   or destruction, issue a copy of the certificate, to the original possessor, on the
   payment of the sum of one dollar ($1).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-206. Penalty for forged certificates
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › A. Boards of Examiners and Certification of Mine Foremen and Assistant Mine Foremen › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-206. Penalty for forged certificates
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-206. Penalty for forged certificates (2023)
content:
If any person or persons shall forge or counterfeit a certificate or knowingly make
   or cause to be made any false statement in any certificate under this act, or in any
   official copy of the same, or shall urge others to do so, or shall alter or use any
   such forged or false certificate, or unofficial copy thereof, or shall make, give,
   alter, produce or make use of any false declaration, representation or statement in
   any such certificate or copy thereof, or any document containing the same, he or they
   shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction thereof, shall be fined two
   hundred dollars ($200), or imprisoned for a term not exceeding one year, or both,
   at the discretion of the court trying the case.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-208. Boards of examiners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-208. Boards of examiners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-208. Boards of examiners (2023)
content:
There shall be established in each of the Counties of Luzerne, Lackawanna, Carbon,
   Schuylkill and Northumberland a board to be known as the “Miners' Examining Board”
   to consist of three miners, who shall be appointed by the judges of the court of common
   pleas of the county from among the most skillful miners actually engaged in said business
   in their respective counties who must have had five years' practical experience in
   the same.  The said persons so appointed shall each serve for a term of two years from the
   date on which their appointment takes effect.  The Miners' Examining Board in the County of Luzerne shall examine the register
   applicants for the Counties of Luzerne and Sullivan;  the Miners' Examining Board
   in the County of Lackawanna shall examine and register applicants for the Counties
   of Lackawanna, Wayne and Susquehanna;  the Miners' Examining Board in the County of
   Carbon shall examine and register applicants for the County of Carbon;  the Miners'
   Examining Board in the County of Schuykill shall examine and register applicants for
   the Counties of Schuylkill and Columbia;  and the Miners' Examining Board for the
   County of Northumberland shall examine and register applicants for the Counties of
   Northumberland and Dauphin.  Each member of the examining board shall receive as compensation for his services
   thirty dollars ($30) per day, for each day actually engaged in this service, and all
   legitimate and necessary traveling expense incurred in attending the meetings of the
   board under the provisions of this act at the prevailing State rate.  The members of the boards shall submit monthly statements approved by the president
   of the board, setting forth the number of days during which each member has actually
   been in attendance at the sessions of the board, together with any expenses that may
   have been incurred, to the Secretary of Mines and Mineral Industries1who, upon approval of the statements shall submit them to the State Treasurer for
   payment.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-207. Certification of miners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-207. Certification of miners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-207. Certification of miners (2023)
content:
No person whosoever shall be employed or engaged in the anthracite coal region of
   this Commonwealth, as a miner in any anthracite coal mine, without having obtained
   a certificate of competency and qualification so to do from the miners' examining
   board of the proper district, and having been duly registered as herein provided.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-272. Employment of boys under eighteen years of age
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-272. Employment of boys under eighteen years of age
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-272. Employment of boys under eighteen years of age (2023)
content:
No boy under eighteen years of age and no woman or girl of any age, shall be employed
   or permitted to be in any mine for the purpose of employment therein.  Nor shall a woman or girl of any age, be employed or permitted to be in or about
   the outside structures or workings of a colliery for the purpose of employment, but
   it is provided, however, that this prohibition shall not affect the employment of
   a female of at least eighteen years of age in an office or in the performance of clerical
   work at a colliery.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-273. Posting of copy of mining law in pamphlet form
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-273. Posting of copy of mining law in pamphlet form
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-273. Posting of copy of mining law in pamphlet form (2023)
content:
For the purpose of making known the provisions of this act to all persons employed
   in or about such mine or colliery to which this act applies, a copy of the law in
   pamphlet form shall be posted in some conspicuous place or places at the mine or colliery,
   where it may be conveniently read by the persons employed, and so often as the same
   become obliterated or destroyed the operator or superintendent shall cause it to be
   renewed with all reasonable dispatch.  Any person who pulls down, injures or defaces such copy of the law when posted up
   in pursuance of the provisions of this act, shall be guilty of an offense against
   this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-209. Organization of miners' examining boards
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-209. Organization of miners' examining boards
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-209. Organization of miners' examining boards (2023)
content:
Each of said boards shall organize by electing one of their members president, and
   one member as secretary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-210. Meeting place of miners' examining boards
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-210. Meeting place of miners' examining boards
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-210. Meeting place of miners' examining boards (2023)
content:
Each of said examining boards shall designate some convenient place within their districts
   for the meeting of the board, but in no case shall such meeting be held in a building
   where any intoxicating liquors are sold.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-211. Registration books of miners' examining boards
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-211. Registration books of miners' examining boards
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-211. Registration books of miners' examining boards (2023)
content:
Each of said boards shall open at the designated place of meeting a book of registration,
   in which shall be registered the name and address of each and every person duly qualified
   under this act to be employed as a miner in an anthracite coal mine.  And it shall be the duty of all persons employed as miners to be properly registered,
   and in case of a removal from the district in which a miner is registered it shall
   be his duty to be registered in the district to which he removes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-212. Application for registration
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-212. Application for registration
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-212. Application for registration (2023)
content:
Application for registration only may be sent by mail to the board, after being properly
   attested before any person authorized to administer an oath or affirmation in the
   county in which the applicant resides.  The form of application shall be subject to such regulation as may be prescribed
   by the boards, but in no case shall any applicant be put to any unnecessary expense
   in order to secure registration.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-271. Roof-bolt support requirements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-271. Roof-bolt support requirements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-271. Roof-bolt support requirements (2023)
content:
Should an operator desire to use roof bolts in lieu of props or timber as conventionally
   used, he shall not be permitted to do so unless permission in writing is first obtained
   from the Secretary of Mines and Mineral Industries.1The Secretary of Mines and Mineral Industries shall grant such permission after
   he has received the approval of a commission of three mine inspectors, one of whom
   shall be the inspector in whose district the mine for which permission is sought to
   use roof bolts is located.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-215. Qualifications for miners' certificates
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-215. Qualifications for miners' certificates
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-215. Qualifications for miners' certificates (2023)
content:
All persons applying for a certificate of competency, or to entitle them to be employed
   as miners, must produce satisfactory evidence of having had not less than two years'
   practical experience as a mine laborer in the mines of this Commonwealth, and in no
   case shall an applicant be deemed competent unless he appear in person before the
   said board and answer intelligently and correctly at least twelve questions in the
   English language pertaining to the requirements of a practical miner, and be properly
   identified, under oath, as a mine laborer by at least one practical miner holding
   a miner's certificate.  The said board shall keep an accurate record of the proceedings of all its meetings,
   and in said record shall show a correct detailed account of the examination of each
   applicant, with the questions asked and their answers, and at each of its meetings
   the board shall keep said record open for public inspection.  Any miner's certificate granted under the provisions of this act, and the hereinafter
   mentioned act approved May 9, 1889 (P.L. 142), shall not be transferable to any person
   or persons whatsoever, and any transfer of the same shall be deemed a violation of
   this act.  Certificates shall be issued only at meetings of said board, and said certificates
   shall note be legal unless then the there signed in person by at least two members
   of said board.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-213. Fee for miners' certificates; fee for registration
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-213. Fee for miners' certificates; fee for registration
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-213. Fee for miners' certificates; fee for registration (2023)
content:
Each applicant for examination and registration and for the certificate hereinafter
   provided, shall pay a fee of two dollars ($2) to the said board, and a fee of one
   dollar ($1) shall be charged for registering any person who shall have been examined
   and registered by any other said board, and the amount derived from these sources
   shall be forwarded monthly to the Secretary of Mines and Mineral Industries1who, upon receipt of same, shall submit the amount of money obtained from the boards
   to the State Treasurer to be applied to the salaries and expenses herein provided.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-274. Gassy mines--No light or fire except approved safety lamps and electric lamps
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-274. Gassy mines--No light or fire except approved safety lamps and electric lamps
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-274. Gassy mines--No light or fire except approved safety lamps and electric lamps (2023)
content:
In each part of all gassy mines no light or fire, other than a locked safety lamp,
   or a locked safety lamp and electric lamp, both of a type which shall be first approved
   by the Department of Mines and Mineral Industries,1shall be allowed or used in such part.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-277. Matches, smokers' articles in gassy mine unlawful; mine foreman to cause search
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-277. Matches, smokers' articles in gassy mine unlawful; mine foreman to cause search
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-277. Matches, smokers' articles in gassy mine unlawful; mine foreman to cause search (2023)
content:
It shall be unlawful for any person or persons, working in a mine or portion of a
   mine, which is worked by locked safety lamps or locked safety lamps and electric lamps,
   to carry into the mine matches, smokers' articles, or any other material or article
   which may cause fire.  To prevent such articles being carried into a dangerous mine or section thereof,
   the mine foreman, when he sees fit, shall cause a search of the men for such articles.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-217. Present holders of miners' certificates exempted
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-217. Present holders of miners' certificates exempted
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-217. Present holders of miners' certificates exempted (2023)
content:
Nothing in this act shall be construed to in any way, except1as herein provided, affect miners' certificates which have been lawfully issued under
   the provisions of the herein mentioned act, approved May 9, 1889 (P.L. 142).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-278. Acetylene burners or blow torches
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-278. Acetylene burners or blow torches
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-278. Acetylene burners or blow torches (2023)
content:
Welding, cutting or soldering with arc or flame, use of blow torch in underground
   face regions shall be done under the direct supervision of the mine foreman or assistant
   mine foreman who shall test for methane before and during such operations in gassy
   mines and shall make a diligent search for fire after such operations in all mines.  Suitable fire extinguishers shall be immediately available during such welding,
   cutting, soldering or use of blow torch.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-216. Unlawful to employ non-certified miners
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-216. Unlawful to employ non-certified miners
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-216. Unlawful to employ non-certified miners (2023)
content:
No person shall hereafter engage as a miner in any anthracite coal mine without having
   obtained such certificate as aforesaid.  And no person shall employ any person as a miner who does not hold such certificate
   as aforesaid, and no mine foreman or superintendent shall permit or suffer any person
   to be employed under him, or in the mines under his charge and supervision as a miner,
   who does not hold such certificate.  Any person or persons who shall violate or fail to comply with the provisions of
   this act, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and, on conviction thereof, shall be sentenced
   to pay a fine of not less than one hundred dollars ($100) and not to exceed five hundred
   dollars ($500), or shall undergo imprisonment for a term not less than thirty days
   and not to exceed six months, or either, or both, at the discretion of the court.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements›H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-279. Notices of accidents to mine inspectors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › Article II. Boards of Examiners; Certification of Mine Foremen, Assistant Mine Foremen, Miners, Superintendents; General Mining Requirements › H. General Responsibility of the Superintendent › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-279. Notices of accidents to mine inspectors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-279. Notices of accidents to mine inspectors (2023)
content:
Notices of death or serious injuries resulting from accidents and any injury resulting
   from a roof-fall accident in or about mines or collieries, shall be made to the inspector
   of mines immediately and shall specify the name, age and occupation of the person
   killed or injured, and also the nature and character of the accident and of the injury
   caused thereby.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-218. Miners' examining boards to investigate complaints
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining › Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965 › B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners › PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-218. Miners' examining boards to investigate complaints
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-218. Miners' examining boards to investigate complaints (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of the several miners' examining boards to investigate all complaints
   or charges of noncompliance or violation of the provisions of this act, and to prosecute
   all persons so offending;  and upon their failure so to do, then it shall become the
   duty of the mine inspector of the district wherein the complaints or charges are made
   to investigate the same and prosecute all persons so offending, and it shall at all
   times be the duty of the mine inspector to prosecute such members of the miners' examining
   board as have failed to perform their duty under the provisions of this act;  but
   nothing herein contained shall prevent any citizen, a resident of this Commonwealth,
   from prosecuting any person or persons violating this act, with power to employ private
   counsel to assist in the prosecution of the same;  upon conviction of any member of
   the miners' examining board for any violation of this act, in addition to the penalties
   herein provided, his office shall be declared vacant, and he shall be deemed ineligible
   to act as a member of the said board.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 52 P.S. Mines and Mining›Chapter 6. Pennsylvania Anthracite Coal Mine Act of 1965›B. Miners' Examining Boards and Certification of Miners›PA ST 52 P.S. § 70-219. Power to administer oaths
